subject: Fatal error, inputs$tree_sections_list is not specified

messages.author: bb17d830c050dbf9
messages.subject: Fatal error, inputs$tree_sections_list is not specified
parts:
Hi all

I've tried to run a stratified analysis. I've have my dispersal and time slices matrix, but the following error emerges when I run the check line:

> check_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)
Read 7 items
Read 262 items

FATAL ERROR: You have time slices, but you do not have 'inputs$tree_sections_list'.
Run 'section_the_tree()' to add tree sections to your input BioGeoBEARS_run_object.

Error en check_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object) : 
FATAL ERROR: You have time slices, but you do not have 'inputs$tree_sections_list'.
Run 'section_the_tree()' to add tree sections to your input BioGeoBEARS_run_object.


The question is, how I can do the tree sections? I have read the functions and it is not clear how I must to figure out it. 

Thanks for any help

Julián

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Fatal error, inputs$tree_sections_list is not specified
parts:
Hi! Look at the example script, and fine the line with "section_the_tree" -- uncomment this line and that will give you the tree sections...

Cheers, Nick
